name: Deck Beasts
description:
About This Game

Create the Ultimate Team

Build a squad of pixel-art beasts and battle your way through the warp in this deck-building auto-battler roguelike. Draft beasts, equip abilities and items, collect relics, and destroy other players with broken builds.

Infinite Possibilities 

With over 100 beasts, hundreds of abilities and items, and 30+ run-defining relics, you decide how your team wins. Rush your enemy down before they get a chance to act, dump hundreds of buffs into one hyper-carry, eliminate key targets with surgical precision, smother the enemy team with waves of debilitating debuffs, or create a completely unique style of your own. With billions of possible combinations, no two runs are ever the same.

Create a Custom Deck

Theorycraft endlessly and fine-tune every aspect of your deck from beasts to relics, or get right into the action with starter decks and a rotating weekly deck. Easily share and swap custom decks with other players to break the meta together.

TONS more coming soon!

  • More Beasts!

  • More Abilities!

  • More Items!

  • More Relics!

  • More Mechanics!

  • More Ways to Play!
